name: vocal-singer-sudoku
description: Offline virtual singer themed Sudoku for Bilibili Toy and Xiaohongshu MiniTool.

scripts.bank: npm run bank:4x4 && npm run bank:9x9
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-build.mjs dist/toy && node scripts/verify-build.mjs dist/xhs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run verify && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1
